summary: First e2e test iteration for FarmDirect Laguna MVP. Executed 24 pytest backend tests (100% pass) covering auth, products, riders, checkout (COD + online/Stripe), orders, seller status updates, rider assignment, and role protection. Ran Playwright UI tests covering marketplace, category/search filters, buyer login, cart quantity+subtotal, COD checkout, orders list with OrderTracker, seller dashboard (post product, incoming orders, advance status, assign rider), buyer registration -> /market, seller registration -> /seller. All critical flows work end-to-end. Stripe /api/checkout returns valid checkout_url and creates order (pending) + payment_transactions record.

minor.issue: Seller sees orders where seller_ids contains their id, but the seller_stats.revenue counts only their own items — mismatch not critical but worth noting for multi-seller carts.
Stock is decremented before payment is confirmed for online payments. If Stripe payment is cancelled/expired the stock is not restored (no cancel/restore logic).
Webhook receives Stripe-Signature but there is no explicit signature secret validation configured (delegated to emergentintegrations); acceptable for shared sandbox but flag for prod.
Returns image_url as relative /api/files/<path>; frontend must prepend backend URL (works because same origin via ingress).

action_items: Consider restoring product stock when a Stripe checkout is cancelled or session expires (currently stock is decremented up-front for online payments).
Optional: add /api/orders/{id}/cancel endpoint so buyers/sellers can cancel unpaid orders.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: stock decrement happens before payment confirmation for online payments — no rollback on cancel/failure.

server.py: CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers may block credentialed CORS requests. Since JWT is also passed via Authorization header + same-origin ingress, current setup works but should be tightened for prod.
server.py: single file ~460 lines is fine for MVP but auth/products/orders/payments should be split into routers before it grows further.
server.py: get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — that's the opposite of the usual convention; acceptable but document it.

seed logic lives in /app/scripts/seed.py (not run on startup) — riders and admin are seeded in startup, but demo seller/buyer/products depend on external seed run. Consider making startup idempotently seed demo data too.
test_credentials: Seller mang.kanor@laguna.ph/farmer123, Buyer aling.nena@laguna.ph/buyer123, Admin wynseldailo5@gmail.com/AdminLaguna123 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_ prefixed users, products and orders. Did not clean up (would require admin DELETE endpoints which don't exist). Impact is minimal since data is namespaced with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 24 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass. Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope but some fixtures share state across classes via pytest.<attr>, so run serially with -n 0 for reliability). Frontend Playwright flows all pass. Only remaining backend concerns are stock-restore-on-cancel (non-critical for MVP) and CORS wildcard-with-credentials (accepted for now).
rca of the issue: No critical bugs found. MVP is functional.
